crossRefs.note: They were willing therefore to receive him into the boat. Immediately the boat was at the land where they were going.

translations.web: Then they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven.
translations.bsb: They rejoiced in the silence, and He guided them to the harbor they desired.
translations.kjv: Then are they glad because they be quiet; so he bringeth them unto their desired haven.
translations.asv: Then are they glad because they are quiet; So he bringeth them unto their desired haven.
